diagram.documentation:
Model guide with overview of diagrams and ontologies contained within this model

 

The main claimed contributions of this model are:

  • An extended SKOS mapping scheme for the purpose of mapping between concepts in an MVF environment, which will be included in an Annex to the MVF specification.
    • Issues.omg.org/browse/MVF11-7 “Additional mapping capabilities between MVF entries would be useful” which reads:
      This might be a new area of exploration, and could apply beyond MVF entries in the context of MVF.
      Currently the metamodel reflects SKOS-like relations such as broader and narrower, but more is needed for certain applications.
      It would be useful to have a non-normative annex demonstrating how one could do this as a starting point for MVF users.
      (Note: This proposed Annex has been accepted in partial resolution of an issue identified prior to Stephen’s engagement: issues.omg.org/issues/MVF11-1)
  •  A UML profile for developing curated MVF vocabularies in UML, with full traceability to Semantic Web equivalents.
  • MVF metamodel with mappings between the various versions of the MVF Specification 1.0 (PDF, XMI, RDF)

----

The following accepted issues identified during development of this model are claimed as minor contributions:

  • ues/MVF11-6 “Include a note to explain the use of generalization and context between MVFEntries”, which reads:
    This represents a generalization as in UML or OWL, at the metamodel level rather than at the UML model level. This may be confusing to users and so an explanatory note is needed to help. Note that the ramifications of this are at the instance level - one instance of an MVF entry may be a generalization of another instance of an MVF entry.The same is true of the additional relationship, which is context, where notes and examples would also be helpful
  • issues.omg.org/issues/MVF11-8 “Consider adding more contextual properties to vocabulary entry”, which reads:
    Investigate whether this should be on vocabulary, vocabulary entry, both, and/or possibly on a more general element as well.
    There may also be an impact on the ontology, depending on the resolution.
  • issues.omg.org/issues/MVF11-12 “The mapping from SKOS Concept to MVF Entry may need further review”

Using this diagram

Exploring the model

  • Each diagram in the model (including this one) has a Documentation box (also referred to as Diagram Info). The text you are reading now is an example of Diagram Info. The bold text at the top of each diagram states the purpose of the diagram. The remaining text provides additional information about the content of the diagram and how to interpret it.
  • The text may also include hyperlinks (blue text) to provide dynamic references to external sources on the Internet and cross-references to related diagrams and elements within the model.
